Prevention: Use healthy/certified seeds (available from seed multipliers, agrodealers, RAB)
Crop rotation for two seasons with tubers or cereals (e.g. maize, potato)
Use resistant or tolerant varieties (eg; Muhondo (G2331), Nyiramata (CAB2), RWR2154, RWV3316, MAC44
Use fertilizers to help plants be more vigorous, basal application organic fertilizer 20-30ton/Ha and
Clean field tools (eg hoe by heat, etc.) after use
Avoid movement in the field when it is wet/touching from infected to non-infected plants
Monitoring: Monitor the field from 2 weeks after planting to pod filling
Observe cotyledons, lower side of the leaves, stem, shoots and pods
Look for symptoms including brick-red to dark brown lesions on above - grounds part of the plants.
On stems, leaf petioles and veins on the lower side of leaves, lesions are usually sunken and elongate.
On pods, lesions are sunken and circular
Take action if you find one plant with anthracnose infection
Direct Control: Captan 80%WP 2 ml in 1 kg of seeds
Restrictions: Do not eat or drink while manipulating pesticides
